{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Scimitar of the Seven Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Scimitar of the Seven Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Scimitar of the Seven Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Scimitar of the Seven Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= {{Icon List|BotW| * Diamond {{Qty|1}} * Flint {{Qty|5}} * Gerudo Scimitar }} }} |value= |location= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Royal Palace]] |TotK= [[Starlight Memories]] }} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 32 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 60 }} |comp= {{List| * [[Gerudo Scimitar]] * [[Moonlight Scimitar]] }} |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Scimitar of the Seven|Scimitars of the Seven|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 32 |durability = 60 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Scimitar of the Seven}} As part of the [[Champion's Arms]], Scimitars of the Seven are commonly used alongside [[Daybreaker]] [[Shield]]s. They belong to the [[Gerudo Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of [[Weapon]]s created and utilized by the [[Gerudo]]. {{Frameless|[[File:BotW Urbosa Artwork.png|thumb|left|200px|alt= Artwork of Urbosa holding her Scimitar of the Seven.|Urbosa with a Scimitar of the Seven]]}} Prior to the [[Great Calamity]], the Gerudo [[Champion]] [[Urbosa]] wielded a Scimitar of the Seven with a Daybreaker. They were created by a Gerudo jeweler. It is said that Urbosa's movements resembled a dance while she used the Scimitar in battle. During the [[EX Recovered Memory]] "[[Champion Urbosa's Song (Memory)|Champion Urbosa's Song]]", Urbosa can be seen using her Scimitar to fight off a pair of [[Yiga Footsoldier]]s attacking [[Zelda]]. [[Riju]] will gift [[Link]] Urbosa's Scimitar of the Seven and Daybreaker after completing the "[[Divine Beast Vah Naboris (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]" [[Main Quest]]. She believes that, since Link was friends with Urbosa, they should be in his possession. They can be found in a pair of [[Stone Chest]]s behind [[Riju's Throne]] in the [[Royal Palace]]. If Link loses the Scimitar of the Seven, he can go to [[Buliara]] to replace it, though it will cost him one [[Diamond]], five pieces of [[Flint]], and a [[Gerudo Scimitar]]. Scimitars of the Seven are made of metal, and will therefore attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. This also means that they are capable of conducting [[Electricity]]. They will sink if dropped in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up again using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. In addition, they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_052" |Life = 60 |Power = 32 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 12 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 13 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 30 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 100 |BuyingPrice = 400 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = One-Handed Weapon |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Scimitar of the Seven}} Scimitars of the Seven return in {{TotK}}. They are one of the few [[Weapon]]s to remain [[Intact Weapon|Intact]] after the rest [[Decayed Weapon|Decayed]] as a result of the [[Upheaval]]. Paired with [[Daybreaker]]s, they are considered part of the [[Arms of the Seven]], which can be made using a technique known by a select few. Currently, [[Isha]] is the only individual who knows how to make them. Both pieces form a bond with their owners that can only be broken when they are permanently lost. {{Frameless|[[File:TotK Riju Artwork 2.png|thumb|right|150px|alt= Artwork of Riju holding her Scimitars of the Seven.|Riju with two Scimitars of the Seven]]}} [[Riju]] now dual-wields two Scimitars of the Seven, which Isha chose to make for her. Isha also claims that her ancestor was responsible for crafting [[Urbosa]]'s Scimitar. Throughout the [[Main Quest]] "[[Riju of Gerudo Town]]", Riju utilizes her Scimitars to fight [[Gibdo]]s with [[Link]]. Most notably, she uses them during the Gibdo invasions of [[Kara Kara Bazaar]] and [[Gerudo Town]], in addition to combating [[Enemy|Enemies]] in the [[Lightning Temple]]. Riju's [[Sage Avatar]] wields projections of her two Scimitars of the Seven, which will still count toward the [[Hyrule Compendium]] if Link takes a [[Picture]] of them. If Riju has been awoken as a [[Sage]], she will appear to help Link during the [[War in the Depths of Hyrule]], where she uses her Scimitars to fight the [[Demon King's Army]]. As part of the [[Side Quest]] "[[Pride of the Gerudo]]", Isha chooses to make a Scimitar of the Seven and Daybreaker for Link. Since Link will be carrying these Arms of the Seven, it is his responsibility to procure the supplies to create them. To make the Scimitar, she requires three [[Diamond]]s, five pieces of [[Flint]], and a [[Gerudo Scimitar]], the latter of which can be either Decayed or an intact [[Gerudo Scimitar✨]]. Once Link has brought Isha the necessary [[Material]]s, she will make a pair of Arms of the Seven for him. When she is done, she gives them to Link, claiming that they are a symbol of the Gerudo's gratitude toward him. If Link ever breaks his Scimitar, Isha offers to make a new one for him. However, she refuses to do so if his Scimitar can still be retrieved, since his bond with it has not been broken. In flashbacks to the [[Imprisoning War]] that took place during the [[Era of Foundation]], the [[Sage of Lightning]] [[Ardi]] can be seen carrying her own Scimitar of the Seven and Daybreaker. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Urbosa Weapon }} Scimitars of the Seven are [[Urbosa]]'s primary [[Weapon]]s. When one is equipped, a [[Daybreaker]] will appear as her [[Shield]]. Additionally, Scimitars of the Seven are the default Weapons used by Urbosa in [[Movie]]s and [[Narration]]s. For example, she draws her Scimitar in "[[Return of the Chief]]", uses it to attack [[Master Kohga]] and [[Sooga]] in "[[Slippery as a Banana Peel!]]", wields it when threatened by a [[Monster]] ambush in "[[A Song from the Past]]", and fights [[Thunderblight Ganon]] with it in "[[Rescue Across Time: Air and Lightning]]". {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} [[Ardi]] uses the Scimitar of the Seven alongside the [[Daybreaker]] in battle. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:TotK Riju Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}Artwork of Riju with her Scimitars of the Seven File:AoC Urbosa Artwork 2.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Artwork of Urbosa with a Scimitar of the Seven File:AoC Scimitar of the Seven Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of a Scimitar of the Seven File:AoC Urbosa Tapestry Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon of Urbosa wielding her Scimitar of the Seven and Daybreaker File:AoI Ardi Artwork.png|{{Game Label|{{AoI|-}}}}Artwork of Ardi with her Scimitar of the Seven ==See Also== {{See Also| * Arms of the Seven * Daybreaker * Gerudo Gear * Gerudo Scimitar * Moonlight Scimitar * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Scimitar of the Seven}}
